response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.instownpct AS own, t.ordertypedist AS otd FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT otd, AVG(own) AS gavg FROM j GROUP BY otd), o AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS oavg FROM j) SELECT AVG(j.own) AS avg_ownership, AVG(j.own / g.gavg) AS avg_ratio_to_type_avg, AVG(j.own - o.oavg) AS avg_excess FROM j JOIN g ON j.otd = g.otd CROSS JOIN o WHERE j.own > o.oavg
